title: Configuration Options
wikitext: Stardew Valley Expanded has multiple configuration settings that you can change based on preference. You can change these by directly editing the config.jsonafter installing the mod and launching the game, but it is '''strongly recommended''' to utilize the [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098 Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)] mod, which displays configuration settings in a user-friendly UI accessible from the title menu. {{Note|All screenshots shown below are with GMCM installed.}} ==SVE Options== {|class="wikitable" !colspan="3"|Configuration Menu - Page 1 |- |colspan="3"|[[File:Config 1.png|center|800px|class=responsive-image]] |- !Option !!Description !!Default |- |Warp Location || * A dropdown with options to determine where the Enchanted Grove warp will deposit the farmer. * default = Places the warp point to match the vanilla Farm Totem warp point. Select this for SVE or Vanilla maps. * Custom = Allows players to move the warp, using the "Enchanted Grove Warp X" and "Enchanted Grove Warp Y" sliders. * Grandpa's Shed = Select this option if '''using a custom farm map''' to move the warp point off the farm and by Grandpa's Shed instead. ''Has no function if using SVE or Vanilla maps.'' | "default" |- |Enchanted Grove Warp X || ''For use with "custom" Warp Location'' * Use the slider to select the X map coordinate for the warp point. | ''N/A'' |- |Enchanted Grove Warp Y || ''For use with "custom" Warp Location'' * Use the slider to select the Y map coordinate for the warp point. | ''N/A'' |- |Seasonal Edits || Adds seasonal changes to buildings and objects; automatically adjusts colors for Starblue Valley and Eemie recolors. || ON |- |Replace Default Fences || Changes the fence sprites throughout the valley; automatically adjusts colors for Starblue Valley and Eemie recolors. || ON |- |Replace Hardwood Fences || Changes the Hardwood Fence sprites; automatically adjusts colors for Starblue Valley and Eemie recolors. || OFF |- |Immersive Shadows || Adds shadows to buildings and other large objects throughout the valley. || ON |- |Mist Effects || Adds mist to many locations during rainy days. {{Note|This impacts performance. It is strongly recommended to disable this option if you experience lag on rainy days.}} |ON |- |SVECommunityBundles || Adds SVE items to Community Center Bundle requirements. {{Note|Will '''NOT''' work with "Remixed Bundles" and '''ONLY''' applies to brand new save files.}} |ON |- |HardSVECommunityBundles || Adds SVE items to Community Center Bundle requirements and increases the difficulty. {{Note|Will '''NOT''' work with "Remixed Bundles" and '''ONLY''' applies to brand new save files.}} |OFF |- |RextexturedFarmhouseKitchen || Redesigns the farmhouse kitchen for all upgrades. || ON |- |RemoveWineryDecorations || Removes all the permanent bar and seating area in the winery farm building, allowing players to place their own decor or machines. || OFF |} {|class="wikitable" !colspan="3"|Configuration Menu - Page 2 |- |colspan="3"|[[File:Config 2.png|center|800px|class=responsive-image]] |- !Option !!Description !!Default |- |Original Mines Entrance || Moves the Mines Entrance back to its vanilla location rather than on the Adventurer's Summit, reducing time it takes to walk to the mines. || OFF |- |Alternative Craftables || Changes the design of several vanilla machines: Furnace, Charcoal Kiln, Bee House, Keg, Seed Maker, Cheese Press, and Mayonnaise Machine || OFF |- |Remove Objects from GrandpasShed || Once unlocked, this option removes all of the permanent decorations in the greenhouse interior on the second floor of Grandpa's Shed. || OFF |- |Remove Southern Cactuses from Desert || Removes a number of cacti in the southern part of Calico Desert to allow for easier placement of objects such as kegs. || OFF |- |Disable SVE Joja Mart Shop || Removes the edits to the vanilla JojaMart, giving other mods edit priority || OFF |- |Balanced Crafting || Adjusts crafting to require more or additional resources while making others easier to craft. {{Note|Recommended to select this option if players are using the [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063 Automate] mod or Frontier/Immersive Farm 2 Remastered maps to better balance resource intake.}} |OFF |- |Harder Building Construction || Buildings require increased materials and cost more to construct. || OFF |- |Stronger Monsters || Monsters deal double damage to players and have slight HP increases. Shadow Brutes and Mummies have significantly increased HP and damage buffs. || OFF |- |ChallengingMarshlands || Increases spawn rates of ghost waves and swamp golems in the Forbidden Maze. More forage spawns as well. || OFF |- |ChallengingHighlandsCavern || Increases monster spawn rates as well as gem and mineral spawn rates. || OFF |- |ChallengingBadlands || Dramatically increases monster spawn rates and the difficulty in traversing the Crimson Badlands. {{Note|This option demands higher computer resources, so having a strong PC is recommended.}} |OFF |- |LowMemoryBadlands || Massively reduces monster spawns in the Crimson Badlands to compensate for lower-memory devices. || OFF |} {|class="wikitable" !colspan="3"|Configuration Menu - Page 3 |- |colspan="3"|[[File:Config 3.png|center|800px|class=responsive-image]] |- !Option !!Description !!Default |- |LowMemoryHighlands || Mssively reduces monster spawns in The Highlands to compensate for lower-memory devices. || OFF |- |Older Sophia Portraits || Changes Sophia's portraits to make her appear older. || OFF |- |Vanilla Sandy Portraits || Removes edits to Sandy's portraits, allowing other mods to have edit priority. || OFF |- |Mature Events || Adds 10 more events that contain extremely serious topics, dark undertones, and moral ambiguity. || OFF |- |Shorter Path to Blue Moon Vineyard || Moves the Cindersap Forest to Blue Moon Vineyard warp point closer to Fairhaven Farm to minimize travel time. || OFF |- |GaldolranGemMuseumMoveable || Allows to Galdoran Gem to be donated to the Stardew Valley Museum. {{Note|This option is strongly recommended for players migrating existing saves from previous SVE versions to prevent being soft-locked from moving the gem to another museum location.}} |OFF |- |Use Galdoran Theme All Times || Changes the UI to the Galdoran Theme at all times. || OFF |- |Disable Galdoran Theme || Disables the Galdoran Theme UI for all locations. This option is useful for players who already have a mod editing the UI. || OFF |} ==Frontier Farm Options== {|class="wikitable" !colspan="3"|Configuration Menu |- |colspan="3"|[[File:Frontier Config.png|center|800px|class=responsive-image]] |- !Option !!Description !!Default |- |SandboxLayout || Removes the interior fences and pathways, except the backyard fencing and the stone pathway on the far eastern side of the map. || OFF |- |LargerGreenhouse || Redesigns the greenhouse interior layout to provide additional crop space and defined tree spots. || ON |- |RemoveGreenhouseObjects || Removes the decorative garden pots and plants. || OFF |- |RemovePicnicTable || Removes the picnic table from the farmhouse backyard. || OFF |- |RemoveEasternVerticalFence || Removes the long span of fence on the east side of the map. || OFF |- |RemoveStonePathways || Removes all of the interior stone pathways. || OFF |- |RemoveTreeHidingBackyardMouseStatue || Removes the tree that blocks visual access to the path to the Farm Warp Totem point. || OFF |- |SmallerBackyardFence || Redesigns the farmhouse backyard to reduce the area contained within the fence. || OFF |- |InstantlyUnlockBridge || Removes the later-game quest from Camilla to repair the bridge to the Frontier and immediately grants access. || OFF |- |InstantlyUnlockDesertShortcut || Removes the later-game quest from Dwarf to create a shortcut from the Farm to Calico Desert. || OFF |- |MistEffects || Adds mist to the farm during rainy days. {{Note|This impacts performance. It is strongly recommended to disable this option if you experience lag on rainy days.}} |ON |} ===Visual Examples=== {|class="wikitable" | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Sandbox 1.png|400px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Sandbox 2.png|400px|class=responsive-image|]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|Sandbox layout toggled ON, with debris || style="text-align:center;"|Sandbox layout toggled ON, no debris |- | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Backyard 1.png|300px|class=responsive-image|Smaller backyard checked]] || style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Backyard 2.png|300px|class=responsive-image]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|Smaller backyard toggled ON || style="text-align:center;"|Smaller backyard toggled ON, no picnic table |- | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Backyard 3.png|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Frontier no fence.png|200px|class=responsive-image]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|RemoveTreeHidingBackyardMouseStatue toggled ON || style="text-align:center;"|RemoveEasternVerticalFence toggled ON |- | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Greenhouse 1.png|200px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Greenhouse 2.png|200px|class=responsive-image]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|LargerGreenhouse toggled ON || style="text-align:center;"|RemoveGreenhouseObjects toggled ON |} ==Grandpa's Farm Options== {|class="wikitable" !colspan="3"|Configuration Menu |- |colspan="3"|[[File:Grandpa's Farm Config.png|center|800px|class=responsive-image]] |- !Option !!Description !!Default |- |MistEffects || Adds mist to the farm during rainy days. {{Note|This impacts performance.
